newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Municipality sells 10.5 pct TVK stake.
newsitem.headline: Municipality sells 10.5 pct TVK stake.

text.p: Hungary's Tiszaujvaros local municipality sold its 10.5 percent stake in chemicals maker Tiszai Vegyi Kombinat (TVK) on the over-the-counter market, the daily Vilaggazdasag said on Wednesday.

The price of the 2.6 million TVK shares sold was probably above the price on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE), but it did not influence the bourse price as the deal was struck outside the BSE, Vilaggazdasag said.
The daily, referring to unnamed sources, said a Hungarian investor or investors bought the shares.
Officials of Tiszaujvaros -- a town in northeast Hungary -- were not immediately available for comment.
TVK, one of the heavyweight issues listed on the BSE, closed at 1,365 forints on Tuesday in Budapest, up 30 forints.
TVK is also traded on the London, Frankfurt and Munnich stock markets.
